as_written_in_papers.quote: All patients in our study underwent NOD2 (NM_022162) genetic analysis, which identified 8 different variants in 13 patients.

cases.statement: One person (P10) in a 13-patient single-centre Chinese cohort; known only from a supplementary table row. Sex, age and zygosity are not stated for this person.

people.label: P10
people.zygosity_or_genotype: not reported (only the variant is listed)
people.other_allele: not applicable (autosomal dominant); no second NOD2 variant listed
people.key_phenotypes: bilateral uveitis; folliculitis; acneiform rash; polyarthritis

quotes.quote: | P10 | c.1471A>T, p.M491L | de novo | Likely Pathogenic (PM2+PP5+PS4+PP3+PM1) | Bilateral uveitis | Folliculitis; Acneiform rash | Polyarthritis | Not performed |

phenotype_specificity.statement: P10 has uveitis, rash and polyarthritis (the Blau triad as the paper defines it). Exome sequencing and the exclusion rule are stated for the whole cohort, not for P10; no other-gene results are reported for P10.

quotes.quote: | P10 | c.1471A>T, p.M491L | de novo | Likely Pathogenic (PM2+PP5+PS4+PP3+PM1) | Bilateral uveitis | Folliculitis; Acneiform rash | Polyarthritis | Not performed |
Whole-exome sequencing was performed in all cases.
Exclusion criteria were strictly limited to patients with other confirmed concomitant rheumatic or autoimmune diseases that mimic BS.

segregation.statement: No affected or unaffected relatives are described in the text; the authors call the M491L case sporadic. Pedigrees are said to be in a supplementary figure that is not in the text available.

quotes.quote: The variants p.R311W, p.R587C, p.M513T, and p.M491L were each identified in a single sporadic case, while one patient carried both p.R471C and p.H496P variants.

de_novo.statement: Table S2 lists the inheritance as de novo, with the pedigree referred to a supplementary figure that is not in the text. Which relatives were tested is not stated beyond the cohort-level method sentence; parentage confirmation is not reported.

quotes.quote: | P10 | c.1471A>T, p.M491L | de novo | Likely Pathogenic (PM2+PP5+PS4+PP3+PM1) | Bilateral uveitis | Folliculitis; Acneiform rash | Polyarthritis | Not performed |
Sanger sequencing was conducted in probands and available family members to confirm identified NOD2 variants.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense (Met464Leu on NP_001357395.1; stated as p.M491L on NM_022162 numbering). The paper gives no variant-specific mechanism statement.

authors_classification.statement: Authors classify it as Likely Pathogenic with criteria PM2+PP5+PS4+PP3+PM1 (Table S2).

quotes.quote: | P10 | c.1471A>T, p.M491L | de novo | Likely Pathogenic (PM2+PP5+PS4+PP3+PM1) | Bilateral uveitis | Folliculitis; Acneiform rash | Polyarthritis | Not performed |

concerns: Numbering: the paper uses NM_022162; the batch's NM_001370466.1 c. and p. numbers are 81 nt / 27 codons lower (c.1471 -> c.1390; M491 -> M464). The stated c.1471A>T and p.M491L are consistent with each other on the paper's numbering.
The variant appears only in summary and supplementary tables of a treatment cohort; there is no case narrative, sex or age for P10.
The de novo entry rests on a table cell and a supplementary pedigree figure not available as text; the authors' own criteria string for P10 includes no de novo criterion.
The authors' criteria string includes population, in-silico and literature criteria, but the paper gives no population figures, prediction scores or prior reports for M491L.
notes_for_panel: Single-person evidence from a supplementary table (Table S2) of a 13-patient cohort (PMID 41673771). Phenotype is the classic triad; everything else (de novo status, testing of relatives) is stated at table or cohort level only.
